steps.situation: ShieldMate shows that someone has typed the wrong password on the reception PC eight times in four minutes.

staff.feedback: Eight failures in four minutes is not a typo. Treat it as a possible break-in attempt.

staff.text: Stop using that PC and tell the owner
staff.feedback: Right. Stay off the PC and make sure the owner knows.

steps.situation: The guesses keep coming from the same address.

staff.feedback: Right. IT can check the account and block the address.

staff.text: Reply to the person guessing and ask them to stop
staff.feedback: Never engage with the attacker. Use contacts saved in ShieldMate.

owner.text: Approve blocking the address for an hour
owner.feedback: Right. A temporary block stops the guessing without risking the clinic's own devices.

owner.text: Do nothing and hope it stops
owner.feedback: One correct guess opens patient records. Act while it is still only guessing.
